_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Theme Settings mapping docs. Hand-curated from the Site Converter's design-system extraction (class-fw-site-converter-stitch.php build_color_presets / typography / button logic + class-fw-site-converter-theme-settings.php importer) cross-referenced against the theme's option groups (unysonplus-theme/framework-customizations/theme/options/*.php, documented in theme-settings-reference.md). Edit THIS file, then run `node scripts/gen-theme-settings-mapping.mjs` to regenerate ai-dev-kit/theme-settings-mapping/*.md. Do NOT hand-edit the generated .md. Option 'status': native = derived from a source signal; via-css = reproduced via generated CSS, native option empty; unmapped = left at default (no source signal / manual); auto = plumbing. Tab 'coverage': populated = the converter writes this tab; partial = only some keys; manual = not converter-populated (set by hand or by the generated child theme).

native.label: Native
native.blurb: Derived and written from a source signal.

via-css.label: Via CSS
via-css.blurb: Reproduced via generated CSS; the native option is left empty (candidate to promote).

unmapped.label: Unmapped
unmapped.blurb: Left at default — no source signal, or set by hand.

auto.label: Auto
auto.blurb: Plumbing. Excluded from the coverage percentage.

tabs.intro: The Colors tab is the site **palette** — the `theme_colors` addable list of `{ name, color }` rows. Each row's name becomes a slug that drives a `.text-{slug}` / `.bg-{slug}` utility and a `--color-{slug}` CSS variable (e.g. **Primary** drives `btn-primary` + `--color-primary`). The converter derives the source's **brand palette** and writes these rows, then merges the plugin's default presets after them (de-duped by hex) so bundled Box / Icon-Badge presets that reference default slugs still resolve.
tabs.recognizerNotes: Brand colours are pulled from the captured design tokens (a real `tailwind.config`) first, then from each element's computed `getComputedStyle` semantic colours, then a markup accent scan / a gradient-accent scan / the primary button's real fill; body text falls back to a sampled ink colour. A brand role only appears when a real colour was found — otherwise the default palette stands. The brand `Primary` is prepended before the default `Primary`, so it wins the `primary` slug and the default button/box presets adopt the brand colour.

options.source: Brand action colour, in priority order: `tailwind.config` accent/primary token → computed semantic primary/accent → vivid markup accent scan → the primary button's real fill → tertiary/secondary/ink → neutral fallback. Wins the `primary` slug (drives `btn-primary` + `--color-primary`).
Source text / foreground colour (`text`, `on-background`, `foreground`), or — when no token exists — **sampled from the real rendered body-copy colour** (`sample_ink`). Falls back to `#1a1a1a`.
`secondary` / `tertiary` token, or the computed semantic `secondary`. Only when found.

Computed semantic `accent`, or — when the design has no named accent — an accent colour **lifted from a source gradient** (`scan_gradient_accent`, e.g. the vivid stop in a hero gradient). Only when found.
`deep-black` / `black` / `surface-container-lowest` token, or semantic `dark`. Only when found.
The plugin's ~20 default color presets, merged in after the brand roles and de-duped by hex — kept (not derived) so bundled Box / Icon-Badge presets that reference their slugs keep resolving.

otherTabs.note: Heading + body font families and the Display / body type scale are derived from the source. Detail page coming next.

The converter runs a background detector across body / sections / footer and writes the site background (`site_background`) + per-section band fills — colour, gradient, photo, OR video (background videos are sideloaded to the media library so they stay editable in the Background → Video picker). The body background is written once as a global Theme Setting so the whole site inherits it. The theme-generator emits `body { background-color: var(--site-bg-color, …) }` (no `!important`) so a later edit still wins.
Container / content width may be carried; most layout options are set by hand.
Selection / scrollbar / focus colours — opt-in, set by hand.
Behavioural / structural defaults — not derived from a source design.

otherTabs.tab: Header (Identity, Layout, Top/Bottom bar, Menu, Mega Menu…)
otherTabs.note: The header chrome comes from the generated child theme + captured menus, not Theme Settings design keys.

otherTabs.tab: Footer (Layout, Pre / Main / Post / Copyright, Widgets…)
otherTabs.note: The footer chrome (columns, menus, widgets) comes from the generated child theme + captured menus. The footer **background fill and muted text colour ARE derived** from the source footer (`detect_footer_style` / `footer_background`).
Post/archive layout defaults — not part of a page conversion.
